Webinar: National Climate Change Risk Assessment call for evidence – Communities, Local Govt, NGOs

The Climate Change Commission is calling for evidence on the next National Climate Change Risk Assessment (NCCRA), which identifies and assesses Aotearoa New Zealand's most significant climate risks and how to manage them.

In this webinar aimed at people working with communities, local government and NGOs, we shared information about the kind of evidence we’re looking for, the risks we have identified, and how you can get involved.
 
This call for evidence closes on 31 March 2025. Read more about the NCCRA and share evidence online: https://haveyoursay.climatecommission.govt.nz/comms-and-engagement/call-for-evidence-nccra2026/

Transport & Infrastructure Committee submission on Offshore Renewable Energy Bill

The Parliamentary Commissioner for the Environment, Simon Upton, along with his chief policy and programmes advisor Matt Paterson and chief counsel Rebecca Thornley present a submission to the Transport and Infrastructure Committee on the Offshore Renewable Energy Bill.

Finance Committee submission on Water Services Bill 18 March 2025 2

The Parliamentary Commissioner for the Environment, Simon Upton, along with his chief advisor of policy and programmes Matt Paterson, chief counsel Rebecca Thornley and senior advisor research and analysis, Anna Hooper, presented a submission to the Finance and Expenditure Committee on the Local Government (Water Services) Bill.

Environment Committee submission on RM (Consenting and Other System Changes) Amendment Bill March 25

The Parliamentary Commissioner for the Environment, Simon Upton, along with chief policy and programmes advisor Matt Paterson and chief counsel Rebecca Thornley, gave a submission to the Environment Committee on the RM (Consenting and Other System Changes) Amendment Bill on 13 March 2025.
